note: Publish `@devup-ui/react`'s type declarations bundled: one file per entry (`@devup-ui/react`, `/compat`, `/stylex`) plus one shared file, instead of one declaration file per source module. A project type-checks 4 declaration files of the package instead of about 50. Behavior change for `moduleResolution: node16`/`nodenext` projects: they used to resolve the package's types to `any` (the per-module declarations imported each other without file extensions), with theme augmentation ignored; they now get the real types, so type errors that were hidden before can appear. With `bundler` and `node10` resolution the exported names and types and theme augmentation are unchanged.
